Definition
[Poincare disk model] \group modelsSource: thurston:page-0019, thurston:page-0020 Let $D^n=\{ x\in \R ^n:\lVert x\rVert <1\} $. In the Poincare disk model of $H^n$, hyperbolic lines and $k$-planes are Euclidean spheres of dimensions $1$ and $k$ orthogonal to $\partial D^n$, with affine planes as limiting cases. The model is conformal and has metric $ds^2=dx^2/(1-r^2)^2$, where $r=\lVert x\rVert $.
